{{Quote|I have Wylenn-brand acoustic beacons. They make a sound that's music to rakghoul ears.|Sergeant Skolin|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Wylenn-brand acoustic beacons''' were devices manufactured by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Wylenn]] that emitted sound which could be used to attract [[rakghoul]]s. In [[3642 BBY]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Skolin]] used such beacons on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] to clear path to the enemy power generators.
